suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 (GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp) is unsafe deserialization in the Kotlin Gradle plugin build cache (affected package org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin, fixed 2.4.20-Beta1). kotlin-stdlib only matches the broad cpe:jetbrains:kotlin; Sangam does not ship or run the Gradle plugin. Reviewed 2026-11-08.

CVE-2026-0994 (GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7) is a JSON recursion-depth bypass in the Python protobuf package (PyPI protobuf, fixed 5.29.6 / 6.33.5); protobuf-java only matches the generic cpe:google:protobuf. Reviewed 2026-11-08.
CVE-2026-54285 is in opentelemetry-js W3CBaggagePropagator (npm, fixed in JS 2.8.0); opentelemetry-api 1.62.0 is the Java API and only matches cpe:opentelemetry. Reviewed 2026-11-17 (alert 28).

opentelemetry-proto 1.10.0-alpha holds the generated Java protobuf classes only; every CVE below is in another language's SDK and matches through cpe:opentelemetry: CVE-2026-54285 opentelemetry-js W3CBaggagePropagator (fixed JS 2.8.0); CVE-2026-44967 opentelemetry-cpp OTLP HTTP exporter (before 1.27.0); CVE-2026-41178 opentelemetry-go baggage Parse; CVE-2026-40894 OpenTelemetry .NET Api/Propagators (up to 1.15.2); CVE-2026-39882 opentelemetry-go OTLP HTTP exporter (before 1.43.0). Reviewed 2026-11-17 (alerts 29-33).
